follow-up time: Until delivery, within 24 hours of induction
exposure: Mode of misoprostol administration (oral vs. vaginal)
cohort: Term pregnant women (37-42 weeks gestation) with a single, live fetus in cephalic presentation, admitted to the labor room and antenatal wards of the Obstetrics and Gynecology department.
finding: Oral misoprostol was similarly effective to vaginal misoprostol for cervical ripening and achieving vaginal delivery within 24 hours, with similar rates of hyperstimulation and cesarean section.
